positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the Virtual Acquisition Office (VAO) development team. VAO is a workforce solution for acquisition professionals. It provides a variety of tools including news, best practices, online courses, assessments, publications, and inquiries. It’s implemented using Sitecore, Solr, C#, ASP.NET MVC, Bootstrap, SQL Server, and PowerShell.
Responsible for the entire software development lifecycle. Planned and executed multiple projects including new features, migration, upgrades, and integration with external systems. Implemented CI/CD pipeline using TeamCity and Octopus Deploy. Worked closely with management and business users, mentored engineers and established best practices.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, development and delivery of digital transformation efforts to enhance the company's digital presence. 
Implemented solutions for customer facing websites using Sitecore, C#, ASP.NET, jQuery, Angular, Bootstrap and SQL Server. Developed RESTful API’s using MuleSoft and ActiveMQ. Built automated tests using nUnit and Selenium.
Leaded DevOps initiative to implement CI/CD pipeline for on-premise and cloud environments releases using Atlassian Bamboo, PowerShell and AWS. 
Championed the adoption of development best practices, code reviews, automated tests, code branching strategies, agile principles and automated deployments.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: Leaded multiple CMS and E-Commerce implementations using products such as Kentico, Umbraco, DotNetNuke, nopCommerce and Magento and performed custom web application development using .NET 3.5/4.0, ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, MVC, Entity Framework, LINQ, JQuery, XML, XSLT, Web Services, WCF, SSIS and SSRS.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: Built the company's custom-made content management and e-commerce platform that was used to implement multiple customers projects. The technologies used were C#, ASP.NET, WCF, SQL Server and Telerik controls.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Participate in the development of e-commerce projects and content management solutions using .NET 2.0, VB .NET, C#, ASP.NET, PHP, Web Services and SQL Server.

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed line of business applications for clients in the government sector using Java and Oracle.

positions.title: Siebel CRM Consultant
positions.description: Provided custom development and support to the Siebel CRM application being used by a major financial institution in Colombia

positions.title: Business Intelligence Technology Specialist
positions.description: Supported technical sales team by performing presentations and projects for enterprise customers about Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing and Data Mining using SQL Server 2000 Analysis Services, .NET 1.1 and Microsoft Office.
